sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in S-V-T. [pause 0.35] In the most common type, a tiny short circuit in the A-V node sends the signal spinning around again and again. [pause 0.4] Every lap fires the ventricles, so the heart races at well over 150 beats a minute. [pause 0.45] If the patient is stable, try vagal maneuvers, then adenosine. [pause 0.35] If unstable, use synchronized cardioversion. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
